data.heading: Set up Claude once, so every new chat already knows your work
data.sub: The Claude Operator's Manual on its own, 217 pages, for $27. It is the Manual from the Operator Bundle, without the 12 Role Packs.
data.body:
If you use Claude and you are tired of re-explaining who you are and what you do in every new chat, this Manual shows you how to set that up once. It is about Claude only.

Inside you will find:

  • Setup in the Claude app, with no coding. Parts I and II cover talking to Claude well, Projects and knowledge files, Skills, and connecting your tools.
  • Claude Code, when you are ready. Part III is for readers who are ready to open a terminal.
  • Workflows to copy. Part IV gives you complete setups you can reuse.
  • Checklists. Every chapter ends with one, and the appendices include a day-one setup checklist.

It is a PDF with 19 chapters. I'm Elvin Peters, and I wrote it.
data.fine: Digital download, in US dollars. A 14-day money-back promise covers this purchase too: email elvin@elvinpeters.com within 14 days for a full refund.
data.small:
Where a detail changes from one release to the next, the Manual explains the idea and points you to the official documentation for the current specifics.

The Claude Operator's Manual is an independent guide. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Anthropic. Claude is a product of Anthropic, and the name is used only to say what the guide covers.
